title: Codex review job gains chatgpt.com egress
summary: The Codex review job's network allowlist in the GitHub Actions workflow gains one host, chatgpt.com:443, taking the job from seven permitted endpoints to eight. The accompanying test in crates/osf/tests/review_workflow.rs is updated in lockstep: its name, its expected host list and its assertion message all move from seven to eight, so the test still pins the allowlist exactly. Nothing else about the job, the container it runs in, or the review pipeline changes.
